title: Towards the Scalable Evaluation of Cooperativeness in Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on evaluating the cooperative tendencies of language models using scenarios based on game-theoretic structures like the Dictator Game, Ultimatum Game, Punishment Game, and Prisoner's Dilemma.
findings: This paper does not report any findings related to religion. Its analysis is focused on the cooperative behavior of language models in game-theoretic scenarios.
